example.title: State Bridge No. 424, Wiggins Mill Road over the Wiggins Mill Pond outlet
example.place: Townsend vicinity, New Castle County, DE

brief: One-lane riveted iron lattice pony truss, 34 ft long and 14 ft 8 in wide on a 15-degree skew, at an old mill seat: the low trusses are close-latticed iron and double as the railing; the plank deck of 4x8s rests on a pair of iron girders and doubled 4x10 timber beams. Semi-coursed rubble abutments and flared wing walls with big cut-granite coping slabs; a plaque in the coping reads the rebuild year and the county commissioner. Gravel farm road between fields and a mill pond outlet.

names.plate: coping plaque: REBUILT 1884 · H. W. MOSELEY, COUNTY COMM.
